items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: And then taking Leo Dejong from us, Eddie Pearson, and I think I was a tailor, formed another band.

ctx.x: Peter I knew, and Charlie I knew, but I never knew Henry.

Charlie. Well Henry was in California. He left the band and went to California. And that's how we had John Porter playing, well that's a different band at the time, that was Creole Serenade. And then to get back to the Sonny South, well, a little before, I think it was Apple tradition or I'm not sure, but anyway, they had a little misunderstanding of Peter I was band. So they're fired, Peter Bull Kies, Charlie, and I don't know if he was born in the middle of the middle, but I think it was three or four of them.…
One of them was playing trombone after the other there.
